items.title: Gasoline Prices Decline for 32nd Straight Day
items.summary: Prices at the pump have tumbled over the past month, with the national average retail price for regular unleaded gasoline dropping for the 32nd consecutive day, to $3.5866 a gallon.

Over 5 years the stock has returned 291.4%, which places significant emphasis on whether the current earnings base can support that kind of re-rating.
